## Triage: first grade · `bug` · `priority:p1` · `target:v18` · `domain:cli` · `pm:queue` · option (a) · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-15T16:55Z

Read fresh. Three pending changesets in the next `18.0.0` prerelease (`pre.json`: tag `next`, nothing consumed yet) state things that later same-release PRs make false:
- `23531-hono-conflict-body.md:15` and `23587-hono-structured-arm-fields.md:14`: "`currentRecord` is held …". PR #23667 serves it.
- `23429-v18-boot-refusal.md:20`, `:27`: "inventory only". PR #23699 (#23684, open) holds back every drift `organization_id` drop.

**Direction (a), by rule, not a decision:** AGENTS.md's `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` row says a falsified entry is amended in itself, never by an erratum in a later one. The maintainer confirmed exactly that class on PR #23626 (batch #349, 「确认修正」).
- So one release-text PR amends the three files in place, before the Version Packages PR #23481 consumes them.
- (b), leaving both stories in one release's notes, is what the rule forbids.

**Grade p1 + `target:v18`:** the text of the next 18 prerelease (「发版本优先的都 p1」). It must land before the next.2 cut, or the cut ships contradicting notes.

**Lane `domain:cli`:** the filing seat's family; the changesets cover `plugin-hono-server`, `rest` and `cli`.

**Scope:**
- Rows 1–2 now.
- Row 3 only once PR #23699 has merged, because the sentence it corrects is true until then. If PR #23699 is not merged when this PR is ready, row 3 rides PR #23699's own changeset as an in-place amendment, and this card says so.
- `Check Changeset`'s step 12 will read this as the deliberate-correction class. It needs the maintainer's one-word confirmation, as PR #23626 did; this seat lists it for the maintainer when the PR opens.
- ⛔ No new "supersedes" changeset.

`finding` leaves on grading.

Claim: PM loop round 21 (#23703: one release-text PR amends, in place, the pending changesets whose sentences later same-release PRs made false — the two Hono "`currentRecord` is held" notes now, and `23429-v18-boot-refusal.md`'s "inventory only" once PR #23699 merges) · 2026-10-15T17:05Z
Session: `session_01Q9PZ5Pzqcus4woVvTZwWNU`
Account: `sunhaolin` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; the card's assignee from this act)
Branch: `claude/issue-23703-release-text-in-place`
Worktree: `objectstack-issue-23703`
Domain: `domain:cli`
Seat: `domain:cli#2` (seat post #22648)
Scope: `batch` 3, by 「并发恢复3」. #23050 slice 4 (PR #23705) and #23684 (PR #23699, in the merge queue) are in flight; this p1 `target:v18` card takes the free slot. #23701 and #23702 (p2) both order after PR #23700, which is a draft.
**This seat's correction, in public:** the ACCEPTs on PR #23667 (`6191403700`) and PR #23699 (`6197474781`) kept the earlier pending changesets byte for byte "per #15953 ruling B", and pointed at a newer changeset that supersedes them. That reading was wrong. `AGENTS.md`'s `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` row says a falsified entry is amended in itself, in a dedicated docs-only PR, ⛔ never by an erratum in a later entry. Triage's grade `6197557639` applies exactly that. This card is the amendment.
File surface (read on `origin/main` `f1e21c4f4`; stop on a breach and explain it in the report):
- **Row 1:** `.changeset/23531-hono-conflict-body.md` (`:15`, the "`currentRecord` is held" sentence).
- **Row 2:** `.changeset/23587-hono-structured-arm-fields.md` (`:14`, the same).
- **Row 3, only once PR #23699 has merged:** `.changeset/23429-v18-boot-refusal.md` (`:20`, `:27`, "inventory only"). If PR #23699 has not merged when the PR is ready, row 3 is left out and this card says so (triage's scope).
- **The newer changesets' cross-references:** only what the amendment makes false.
  - `.changeset/23531-hono-conflict-current-record.md`'s "This supersedes the earlier note …" points at a note that will no longer exist.
  - `.changeset/23684-drop-gate-host-tables.md`'s FROM, once row 3 is amended.
  - ⛔ No new "supersedes" changeset.
- ⛔ **Hold-offs:** no code, test or docs page; no `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md`; no `content/docs/releases/`; and no `skip-changeset` (ruling D on #18375: never on a PR that edits an existing changeset).
Container & model: `S` (release text in up to five pending changeset files), `mode:subagent`, `model: default tier`.
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: `the release text of @objectstack/plugin-hono-server, @objectstack/hono and @objectstack/cli for the next 18.0.0 pre-release (this lane) | PR #23667 and PR #23699, whose behaviour the text must match, read | every reader of the next.2 CHANGELOGs`
Thread-read: 6197557639
Serial constraints cleared:
- No open PR edits these five changeset files (read at this act), except PR #23699, which adds `.changeset/23684-drop-gate-host-tables.md` and is in the merge queue. Row 3 and that file wait for its merge.
- **Landing:** `Check Changeset` reads this diff as the DELIBERATE CORRECTION class (route 0, red by design). Per `landing-operations.md` that red does not wait for the maintainer. This seat's ACCEPT confirms it, quoting each amended note before and after.
